Introducing Saved Views, available today for everyone on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters and sort order every morning just to check your team's overdue tasks, this one's for you.

Saved Views let you capture any combination of filters, grouping, and sorting as a single click you can return to whenever you need it. Set up a view for "My tasks due this week," "Bugs assigned to QA," or "Unassigned items in Marketing," and it's there waiting the next time you open the list.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving plenty of room to organize by project, client, sprint, or personal workflow. And because work rarely happens alone, any view can be shared with your team, so everyone gets the same lens on the same data without repeating the setup.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, and it's ready to use right now. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
